sentences.text:
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.459/2025 registered at Police Station Tendukheda, District Narsinghpur (M.P.), for the offence punishable under Sections 376(1),
376(2)(n), 376(3), 34 of IPC and Sections 5(1), 6, 5j(ii), 5(1)/6, 5(j)(ii)/6 of POCSO Act and 9 and 10 of Bal Vivah Act.

Applicant is in custody since 09.12.2025.
2.
As per prosecution case, on 08.12.2025 the police personnel came to know that the prosecutrix who is 17 years and 9 months old was admitted in the hospital and she is pregnant.

FIR was registered, during investigation, it was found that on 22.05.2022 the marriage of the elder sister of the prosecutrix was fixed to be solemnized with the present applicant, but elder sister of the prosecutrix had eloped with some other boy

, thereafter, parents NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-JBP:24799 2 MCRC-12300-2026 of the prosecutrix had got their younger daughter married with the present applicant.
Thereafter she was residing with the applicant as husband and wife and subsequently she got pregnant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been fallaciously roped in the crime.
Parents of the prosecutrix had got married of the prosecutrix with him.
He was not aware of the age of the prosecutrix at the time of the marriage.
He was living with the prosecutrix as husband and wife because they have been married to each other.
He is jail since 09.12.2025.
On these premise, learned counsel for the applicant prays that the applicant may be released on bail.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State submits that the age of the prosecutrix is under the age of 18 years, thus he prays for outright dismissal of the application.
5. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant namely Manoj Adiwasi shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed during the pendency of trial.
6. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the BNSS.
7. Accordingly, this MCRC stands disposed of.
